```elixir title="Elixir"

      :handle_strong => fn(_args) ->
        :skip
      end,
    }

result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Normal <strong>bold text</strong> normal</p>", %{visitor: visitor})
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
